# Flecs C, upstream master plus open PRs

`distr/flecs.c` and `distr/flecs.h` are Flecs C's own amalgamation (`distr/`, regenerated by bake) at
[`andrewgazelka/flecs@b18f84ad0`](https://github.com/andrewgazelka/flecs/commit/b18f84ad03ae02e42830e32634d65b7bcbadeafd)
(branch `combined-fixes`), copied unchanged. That commit is upstream SanderMertens/flecs master
`72a531d6f706c19629f15f3d49cb12a8d5dbe5e1` ("[script] Use Parent hierarchy by default for prefab and template scopes",
2026-10-27; 645 commits past `6e4cd338a`, which 4.1.6 shipped as; `FLECS_VERSION_*` still says 4.1.6) plus the four
fixes below, one commit each, each open as a PR against upstream master:

- [#2347](https://github.com/SanderMertens/flecs/pull/2347) Detect WebAssembly targets other than Emscripten:
  `__wasm__` (wasm32-unknown-unknown, `crates/flecs-c/wasm-libc`) sets `ECS_TARGET_WASM` and `ECS_TARGET_POSIX` and
  includes no `execinfo.h`. Without it the build falls back to the `_s` string functions and fails.
- [#2348](https://github.com/SanderMertens/flecs/pull/2348) Check string buffer growth for overflow and allocation
  failure: `flecs_strbuf_grow` no longer wraps its `int32_t` size past 1 GiB into a NULL buffer that later asserts
  `b->content != NULL`; it grows to at most `INT32_MAX` and aborts with `ECS_OUT_OF_MEMORY` when it cannot grow or the
  allocation fails.
- [#2349](https://github.com/SanderMertens/flecs/pull/2349) Enable query plans for builds with meta and prefabs: a
  custom build with SCRIPT (so META) and PREFAB but no QUERY_PLANS aborted in `ecs_init`, because meta's struct base
  and units observers need a query plan once IsA is transitive. `crates/flecs-c/build.rs` relies on this and does
  not define `FLECS_QUERY_PLANS` itself.
- [#2350](https://github.com/SanderMertens/flecs/pull/2350) Add a readonly option to the REST server: `EcsRest`'s
  `readonly` (copied into `ecs_rest_ctx_t`) makes the server reply 403 to every request but `GET`, and to
  `GET /call/`. The `rest` feature of `crates/flecs-c` (native only) sets it on every server `glue_rest_new` makes.

There are no local changes: per AGENTS.md, a Flecs fix goes upstream as a PR, and this file pins the fork commit
that holds the open ones. When a PR merges, move the pin to an upstream master commit that has it, rebasing
`combined-fixes` onto that commit for the PRs still open; when all have merged, pin plain upstream master.

To move the pin: in the Flecs checkout, rebase `combined-fixes` onto the new master, run `bake --cfg release` at the
root after each commit to regenerate `distr/` (commit it with the fix), push the branch to andrewgazelka/flecs, copy
`distr/flecs.c` and `distr/flecs.h` here, update the commits above, and run `uv run build.py --test`.

Dropped from the old pin (the space game's fork of 4.1.6), with no PR needed:

- `rgb-fork.patch`, upstream `ed776dd` (#2219, no opaque callbacks under a meta cursor with no data): upstream has it.
- exact JSON floats and `rgb-rest-gate.patch` (REST writes gated): the JSON and REST addons are not compiled here
  by default (`crates/flecs-c/build.rs`; the native-only `rest` feature adds them, with writes refused by #2350's
  `readonly` rather than a patch), so the hunks changed nothing this library runs.
- the Flecs-Rust `FLECS_MUT_ALIAS_LOCKS` hunks the game's copy carries: this library never defines it.

The space game's pin is separate and behind: Flecs C `6e4cd338a` (4.1.6) plus its fork, in the game's
`vendor/flecs_ecs_sys/src/`. A copy of those two files is `../flecs_ecs_sys/src/flecs.{c,h}`, which host-check builds
so that host mode (the `host` feature of `flecs-c`, SPEC.md "Host worlds") is still checked against the game's Flecs:
in host mode `crates/flecs-c` compiles `csrc/glue.c` against the host's `flecs.h`, not this one. Nothing requires the
two pins to be equal any more.
